metrics.name: drc_precision
metrics.note: Floor moved down from 0.0775, deliberately, not silently: this round's harness-independence and custom-rule-clearance fixes (see REPORT.md) stop issue11814 (QA corpus) from timing out, and once it runs to completion it trips ~2900 pre-existing, out-of-scope track_width/routing_track_width false positives on its own (GAPS.md #10 -- that provider checks every track against the board/netclass *nominal* width as if it were KiCad's actual minimum-width constraint, which is usually much smaller) that the timeout previously hid from this metric entirely. tracks_crossing (1567->0 false positives) and hole_clearance (0->179/179 matched) are both genuinely fixed this round -- see REPORT.md's per-type table.

metrics.name: drc_recall
metrics.note: Same cause as drc_precision's note: issue11814 newly completes instead of timing out, and its track_width over-firing (GAPS.md #10, pre-existing, out of scope) dominates the honest, larger sample this floor is now based on.
